subject: [RFC PATCH 17/57] mm/collapse: copy the sources into the destinations

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a new function, collapse_copy, which copies pages from source candidates to their corresponding destinations in memory. The copy operation is performed for each candidate that has both frozen and has a destination folio. If the source page does not exist, it is zero-filled. The function also handles machine checks on source pages and records any failures. The patch modifies the collapse_provision function to publish each destination folio in place of its corresponding sources.
